description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.
The token that is used to start the next query.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The type of the resource. Set the value to ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi list-tag-keys --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --resource-type ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-wwo0000iw02 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
